c7a.interval: one joint exact interval for balanced accuracy: inversion of the exact unconditional test of H: BA <= b (and its mirror), jobs as independent Bernoulli trials
c7a.powerPrecondition: the chance that the exact interval excludes a null classifier: P(lower bound > 0.5) for a classifier with TPR = TNR = 0.9 at the realised confident class counts must be >= 0.8 (prereg-rules.mjs c7aPower pExclude); otherwise C7a reads INCONCLUSIVE (not powered) and no decisive reading, F12 included, is read. The perfect classifier's lower bound is still printed, as is the chance a coin-flip classifier reads REFUTED
c7a.refuted: F12 / REFUTED only when the upper bound is below 0.7 (a useful balanced accuracy is excluded) and the lower bound is <= 0.5; lower bound > 0.5 with upper bound < 0.7 reads ABOVE-CHANCE-BELOW-USEFUL; lower bound <= 0.5 < 0.7 <= upper bound reads INCONCLUSIVE (uninformative), never REFUTED
c7a.minimumNote: c7aMinimumCounts (symmetric): with 3 or fewer confident jobs of a class C7a is not powered at up to 24 of the other; at least 12 confident jobs in all

signFlip.floor: 2^-(informative clusters), informative = clusters with Delta_c != 0 (the policy chose a different mode from SBS-train on some job of the cluster); printed with every reading

g1.refute: exact one-sided 95% cluster-level sign-flip upper bound per cell (finite only with >= 5 TRAIN clusters)
g1.continue: a lower bound > 0 at V = $1 in some cell: exact cluster-level, or the job-level (task -> replicate) bootstrap labelled diagnostic
g1.fourClusters: with 4 TRAIN clusters G1 can only read CONTINUE or OWNER-DECIDES

analysis.labelConfidence: per job, bootstrap over tasks then replicates or lineages (no cluster level)

theta.candidates: midpoints between adjacent distinct values among confident TRAIN jobs, plus +infinity
theta.ties: larger thresholds, key by key (logInputTokens, then maxListLength)
theta.belowMinimum: H0 not fitted: C7a INCONCLUSIVE; NR-static and the tuned size rule have one leaf (SBS-train)
theta.locoUndefinedFold: a fold whose training part lacks a confident positive or negative is undefined: excluded from LOCO statistics and counted, never theta = +infinity

levels.C7b SUPPORTED: one-sided at the Holm level (0.025 first, 0.05 second)
levels.C7b REFUTED: one-sided 95% upper bound at each V (intersection-union: no correction)
levels.C7b HARMFUL: Holm over the 6 (policy, V) tests of H: Delta >= 0 at familywise 0.05
levels.C7a: two-sided 95% exact joint interval (0.025 per side)
levels.G1: exact one-sided 95% per cell (intersection-union for REFUTED-PREMISE)

analysis.maskedFallback: where a mode is masked on a job (direct-H on interactive families), SBS-train and every router take the next mode of their own TRAIN ranking for that cell; every fallback is counted and printed per policy
analysis.missingData: a job missing any primary mode of its menu (masked modes excepted), for any reason, leaves Delta and C7a and is printed on the dropped line; a conditional job that does not run (codefix-notests) leaves TRAIN: TRAIN counts, G1 and the power gate are recomputed on what ran

requiredRules.when: a warning while the analysis may still change; an error once the PREREG §4.4 A-Freeze row is filled (the Freeze addendum pins the analysis)

powerGate.rule: computed at the planned held-out cluster count n and at n - 1 (r3p, the near and dev-observed cluster, dropped), because SUPPORTED needs the same reading without r3p; the gate passes only when both pass (prereg-rules.mjs powerGate)

analysis.voidPolicy: fail: a voided lineage (hidden-path or nested-model attempts, the ownerci copy scan) or voided agent draw scores as a failure on every task in the primary analysis (metrics.mjs needTable voidPolicy fail); its job stays in Delta and C7a and the void is listed; dropping voided lineages (voidPolicy drop) is a not-primary sensitivity. A void is never a missing-data reason

meterGate.informedBy: D6 (research/need-router-20261014/analysis/m0/REPORT.md, D6; PREREG §13 D9): re-priced Opus agent sessions land 2.11x-2.96x below the CLI figure because per-message usage lines miss output tokens, and every archived cache write was billed at the 1-hour rate
meterGate.utility: a session the meter gate books meterUnverified (its re-price misses the CLI figure beyond the 10% band) enters utility at the CLI-reported figure: re-priced dollars plus the gap (usdMeterGap), never the re-price alone
meterGate.imputedRule: the meter-gate gap (usdMeterGap) is not an imputed bound: it is the CLI's own observed figure, so it does not count toward the 30%-imputed rule (metrics.mjs moves it from usdImputed to observed dollars); it is counted and printed per cell. Sensitivity, not primary: the 30% rule with the gap counted as imputed
meterGate.cacheWrite: the price table prices cache writes at the 5-minute rate (1.25 x input); the rate billed is the one the launch environment sets. D6 found every archived cache write billed at the 1-hour rate (2 x input). The paid launch shape (PREREG §12) sets FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M=1, and the meter-verification record that clears the gate must come from transcripts of that launch shape; if they still show 1-hour writes, the table gains the 1-hour rate by a §13 deviation before the stage starts
meterGate.waiver: a stage launched under the owner's meter-gate waiver (analysis/m0/meter-gate-waiver.json) is a §13 deviation, recorded before its labels are used

jevFeatureDecision.rule: the Freeze decision on whether Jev property features enter NR-knn reads J-NEED-2 recomputed without wbed-r3p: no r3p fold, and r3p's 24 tasks and their one-call outcomes in no training fold (leave-one-family-out over the 7 TRAIN-side W rungs). The published J-NEED-2 numbers, which include r3p, are never read for it

spendMeter.rule: per stage (and per M1 tag): sum over rows of max(reported, re-priced) when the row has an observed cost, else the row's bound; plus the reserved bound of every start in flight (reserved before launch); a start is refused when meter + its bound > the cap
spendMeter.appliesTo: every paid runner (label-run.mjs, m1-run.mjs, judge-H, probes, DRIFT)
spendMeter.setAside: an attempt set aside outside the results (an invalid attempt, an environment-fault row re-run later) counts like a row: at max(reported, re-priced) when its cost was observed, else at its bound
spendMeter.overshoot: a CLI agent session or a construct build is stopped at its budget only between turns (--max-budget-usd, passed at src/executors/claude-code.mjs:304; 'a soft bound: the CLI checks it between turns' is the executor's comment at :290, a documentation claim, not measured), so a start can be charged above its reserved bound; the meter books the charge after the fact. Worst case: a stage ends above its cap by the overshoot of the starts in flight when the cap binds (at most 4). Archived evidence ($0, PREREG §13 D9): 273 JIT agent and interpreter sessions with a known budget, none reported above it (largest 1.00x, one costUnknown session booked at its bound); 8 C0 builds at most 0.28x of the $8 builder budget, gateway overshoot $0. Reporting: each start's bound and charge are in spend.jsonl; label-run.mjs marks a start settled above its bound with overBoundUsd there, prints overBoundStarts, overBoundUsd and overCapUsd in report totals.spend, and stops a stage whose meter is over its cap (STAGE_CAP_OVERRUN, K5). The overshoot counts on the meter and in committed spend (totals.committedUsd). Rule: a stage whose totals.spend.overBoundUsd exceeds 10% of its cap is a PREREG §13 record before the next paid stage, which raises later reservation bounds by the largest charge-to-bound ratio observed

labelEngine.beds: the transitive bed-import closure of the families of the jobs in the stage
labelEngine.note: metrics.mjs is in both records: label-run reads it for racing top-ups

allowedChanges: a bed directory that no earlier paid stage's label-engine stamp holds: its first paid use (the TRAIN families first run in NL1, the codefix-notests generator, the held-out families in NL2p and NL2)
engineStamp.otherwise: any other difference from the latest earlier label-engine stamp (files, trees, the preregistered arms, prices, seeds, grid, derived cascades and meter, the need ledger, Node, the CLI), or a bed that differs from any earlier stamp that used it, is a §13 deviation recorded before the later stage starts
